title: Return Scan Prefix
statement: Let $W$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine, let $a,R,n$ be natural numbers, let $B$ be a base controller configuration, and let $u$ be an integer. Suppose the base guide tape is the fixed guide of radius $R$, and $n\le R$. After $n$ schedule steps from the return-to-center phase with unary-counter head at $u$ and guide head at $-R$, the controller remains in the return-to-center phase and the guide head is at $-R+n$.
hypotheses_covered: $W$ is a finite Boolean Turing machine
The base guide tape equals the fixed guide of radius $R$
replaced:
Suppose the base's guide tape is the fixed guide of radius $R$ and let $n \le R$.
Running the schedule controller for $n$ steps from the return-to-center phase with
guide head at $-R$ stays in the return phase and moves the guide head to $-R + n$.
